[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]
== Biography ==
'''Isobell Glasgow''' was baptised at Glencorse on 26 December 1714. The register names her parents as Robert Glasgow and Margaret Davidson.<ref name="baptism">Scotland's People, Church of Scotland old parish registers, Isobell Glasgow, 26 December 1714, parents Robert Glasgow and Margaret Davidson, Glencorse parish 687, reference 10/106, [https://www.scotlandspeople.gov.uk/search-records/church-registers/church-births-baptisms official search portal].</ref>

The named couple is represented by [[Glasgow-3011|Robert Glasgow]] and [[Davidson-20783|Margaret Davidson]], whose marriage was recorded at Glencorse in 1704.

== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-3011]] is assessed at 89% (probable). Isobell’s 1714 index explicitly names Robert and Margaret Davidson; the local marriage and two earlier siblings support Robert-3011, though his 1676-child identity remains probable. The Stitchel namesake is excluded by different parents.

Existing child-to-father link assessed from held public evidence; 1676 Glencorse child to 1704 Davidson groom/father is a probable identity, not a literal statement in the child records; shipmaster identity remains separate.

Next useful test: Read the Glencorse original for an adult identifier rather than rechecking the excluded namesake.

Source basis already held: [https://www.scotlandspeople.gov.uk/search-records/church-registers/church-births-baptisms Scotland's People, Church of Scotland old parish registers, Isobell Glasgow, 26 December 1714, parents Robert Glasgow and Margaret Davidson, Glencorse parish 687, reference 10/106, official search portal (https://www.scotlandspeople.gov.uk/search-records/church-registers/church-births-baptisms).]. No new father attached; cited evidence and any inspected register entry are scoped above.


Robert Glasgow and Margaret Davidson married at Glencorse on 8 June 1704.<ref name="marriage">Scotland's People, Church of Scotland old parish registers, Robert Glasgow and Margaret Davidson, 8 June 1704, Glencorse parish 687, reference 20/53, [https://www.scotlandspeople.gov.uk/search-records/church-registers/church-banns-marriages  official search portal].</ref> The baptism proves the parental names, but does not by itself uniquely identify the father as [[Glasgow-3011|Robert Glasgow]]. Both parent links are therefore marked uncertain pending an occupation, probate record, or other evidence establishing continuity for the couple.

[[Glasgow-1443|Isobell Glasgow]] was christened at Stitchel in 1716 to Patrick Glasgow and Helen Fairbarn. FamilySearch entries FMMM-S4T and FMMM-S4Y confirm that she is a separate person.
